items.title: The Game Theory of AI with Aza Raskin
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Gary O'Reilly, Chuck Nice, Aza Raskin
items.content:
Are we losing control of AI? Neil deGrasse Tyson and co-hosts Chuck Nice and Gary O’Reilly explore AI cyberhacking breaches, supercoordation, and the game theory of the AI alignment problem with Aza Raskin, co-founder of the Center for Humane Technology and the Earth Species Project.

items.title: Bose-Einstein Condensate, Collisions, The Physics of Fire –TYTYK
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice
items.content:
What happens to matter when the temperature gets near zero kelvin? Neil deGrasse Tyson and Chuck Nice explore things you thought you knew about Bose-Einstein condensate, high impact collisions, and how stuff burns. 

NOTE: StarTalk+ Patrons can listen to this entire episode commercial-free here: https://startalkmedia.com/show/bose-einstein-condensate-collisions-the-physics-of-fire-tytyk/

items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Eugene Mirman, Mary Roach, Brian Malow, Joe Nickell, Phil Plait

items.title: In Theory with Janna Levin
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Janna Levin
items.content:
If something is possible, has the universe tried it? Are all physical possibilities inevitable? Neil deGrasse Tyson sits down with theoretical astrophysicist Janna Levin to launch “In Theory,” a new StarTalk series celebrating the weird, wacky theories of the universe and the theorists who chase them. Out on YouTube October 29, 2026!

items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice, Gary O'Reilly, Morgan McSweeney

items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Negin Farsad, Kate Biberdorf
items.content:

items.title: Cosmic Queries – Light Sails & Quantum Scales
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice
items.content:

items.title: What Is Intelligence? With David Krakauer
items.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson, Chuck Nice, Gary O'Reilly, David Krakauer
items.content:
